boundaries.current_conditions: The polygons show modeled potential flooding during the named rain scenario; they do not report what is flooded now.
boundaries.routing: Flood polygons are context only and never select, penalize, certify, or clear a walking route.
boundaries.no_overlap: No overlap means only that the route does not intersect this model snapshot; flooding can still occur elsewhere.

properties.label: Potential deep, contiguous flooding
properties.depthBand: 1 foot or more in the modeled scenario
properties.detail: DEP’s model includes this area for potential deep and contiguous flooding of at least 1 foot during the named heavy-rain scenario. This is not a live street condition.

properties.label: Potential nuisance ponding
properties.depthBand: 4 inches to less than 1 foot in the modeled scenario
properties.detail: DEP’s model includes this area for potential ponding of at least 4 inches and less than 1 foot during the named heavy-rain scenario. This is not a live street condition.
